'''Devlikks''' were an [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. They had long necks, shoulders covered in green feathers, a small green tail, and oddly-shaped heads. The average lifespan for a Devlikk was about nine to 10 years; most Devlikk succumbed to senility at age 9. The [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]] was of this species, as was his son [[Wan Sandage Jr.]], along with [[Raido]], [[Sherloo]], and [[Narralla]].

==Society and culture==
The Devlikk [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] featured [[City/Legends|cities]] laid out like enormous mazes. While offworlders found the configuration off-putting, Devlikks had little trouble navigating the passageways due to their innate magnetic sense.<ref name="NEGC ">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Although their bodies were only somewhat [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], Devlikks made do with devices and furnishings, such as chairs, aimed at species with longer legs.<ref name="PRT">"[[Podracing Tales]]".</ref> While Devlikks operated comfortably without clothing,<ref name="EIIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']].</ref> they sometimes dressed in items such as [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]], tabards, chaps,<ref name="EIRNSG ">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref> [[Bandolier/Legends|bandoleers]], or [[shirt]]s.<ref name="R33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]].</ref> Another Devlikk fashion was to bind the hair of the cheeks into ponytails.<ref name="PRT" />
